_comment: PR 2 phase A batch — 20 hand-picked persons whose 'other bands' will bridge-fill the graph, plus 4 direct-ingest bands (Oasis, Blur, Motorhead, Iron Maiden) that add new nodes with all their members. The persons were selected by combining top-connected members from the existing graph (Duff McKagan is in 7 seed bands, so his MB entry will pull in his GnR/Velvet Revolver/Loaded/etc. connections) with iconic Seattle-scene figures whose careers span many projects (Grohl, Cornell, Staley, Vedder). Direct-ingest bands are notable UK acts requested for scene diversity.
